name: account_login
description: Access issues, 2FA/backup codes, business account setup, credential problems.

name: billing_subscription
description: Charges, refunds, plan pricing, cancellations or downgrades.

name: sync_technical_bug
description: Files not syncing, app or website errors, crashes, broken features.

name: how_to_usage
description: "How do I do X" -- nothing is broken, the customer just needs guidance.

name: data_loss_recovery
description: Deleted or missing files, restore requests. Higher urgency than a general bug.

name: feature_request
description: Suggestions or product feedback -- not a problem to fix.

name: followup_ticket_status
description: Referencing an existing ticket or case, nudging for a response. Not a new issue.

name: general_feedback_or_other
description: Thanks, praise, venting/rants, spam, or fragments too ambiguous to route to a technical bucket.
